messages.content: What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?

function.name: get_earliest_reference
function.description: Retrieve the earliest historical reference of a person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

source.description: Source to fetch the reference. Default is 'scriptures'

message.reasoning: We need to answer: earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record. The user asks: "What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" We should provide the earliest known historical reference outside of Christian scriptures. That would be the mention by the Jewish historian Flavius Josephus in his Antiquities of the Jews, written around 93-94 CE, specifically the Testimonium Flavianum. Also references by Tacitus (c. 116 CE) and Pliny the Younger (c. 112 CE). But earliest is Josephus. There's also the mention by the Roman Emperor Hadrian? No. So answer: Josephus. Provide details: The Testimonium Flavianum in Antiquities 18.3.3. Also mention that some scholars debate authenticity. Provide context. Also mention that the earliest mention is in the works of Josephus, but the earliest surviving text is from the 2nd century. Provide citations. Also mention that the earliest mention in a non-Christian source is by the Roman historian Tacitus in Annals 15.44, but that is later. So answer: Josephus. Provide explanation. Also mention that the earliest mention in a Christian context is the New Testament, but the question is about historical record. So answer accordingly.
